sources.title: EuroSafeAI — Making AI Safe for Humanity
sources.snippet: We identify seven failure modes through which AI poses risks to social systems — from belief homogenization and epistemic floods to power concentration and normative centralization — and argue that AI safety must complement model-level benchmarks with system-level evaluation that captures these aggregate institutional effects.

sources.title: EuroSafeAI — Making AI Safe for Humanity
sources.snippet: EuroSafeAI is a nonprofit AI safety organization led by Prof. Zhijing Jin, working on misuse, misalignment, and risks to democracy.
